title: Stained Glass Dreamweaver
description: A woman in a cosmic bikini takes a selfie while sitting on a bed in a surreal bedroom. The scene is framed by vibrant stained glass panels depicting a sun landscape on the left, a mystical night tree and castle on the right, with floating books, butterflies, and a glowing celestial ceiling above her.
prompt: A beautiful woman with tan skin wearing a cosmic galaxy and sun bikini sits on a bed taking a selfie with her phone, surrounded by a surreal dreamlike bedroom with a giant mystical tree and castle visible through an open view, the entire scene framed by colorful stained glass panels showing a sunrise landscape on the left and night sky motifs on the right, floating books and butterflies in the air, glowing celestial patterns on the ceiling with light rays beaming down, intricate details, vibrant fantasy style
